description: Ministry of  City Planning & Water Supply - Order to acquire the lands in Nuwaraeliya for Nanuoya Water Supply project and Kandy District for Yahalatenna Service Reservoir
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains three separate orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act approving the acquisition of specific immovable properties (land parcels) for water supply infrastructure projects. Each order includes detailed schedules describing the exact location, boundaries, extent, and claimants of the land parcels being acquired. The content focuses exclusively on land/property matters without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
